sentences.text: This ancient ray possessed eyes and spiracles positioned on the top of its head, while its mouth and gill slits faced downward. Its greatly expanded pectoral fins were adapted specifically for swimming.
The genus was first described by Thiollière in 1848. Scientists have since recorded 22 fossil occurrences of this species.
Taxonomically, the genus belongs to the class Chondrichthyes and is classified within the family Rhinobatidae.
Spathobatis was an extinct genus of rays that lived in Europe during the Jurassic period. It existed from the Aalenian to the Albian stages, between 174.7 and 106.3 million years ago.
